text: Swag Golf is a private golf accessory, equipment and apparel company based in Northbrook, Illinois, founded by Nick Venson, its chief executive. In October 2023 it closed a $10m growth funding round led by Verance Capital, joined by Aurum Partners (a San Francisco 49ers-affiliated fund), Shaun White, Zach LaVine and others.
short: Swag Golf is a private company founded and led by Nick Venson, with growth investors led by Verance Capital.

source.name: SGB Media: Swag Golf Raises $10 Million in Funding Round
source.quote: Swag Golf, a golf accessory, equipment and apparel company based in Northbrook, IL, closed a $10 million growth funding round led by Verance Capital
source.note: The same article identifies 'Nick Venson, Swag Golf's founder and CEO' and names the additional participants Aurum Partners, Shaun White, Zach LaVine, Alex Cohen, Howard Lindzon and Greg Zeeman.
